About The Company

L3Harris Technologies is a leading defense technology provider committed to delivering innovative solutions that address the most critical challenges faced by national security and defense agencies. With a focus on integrating space, air, land, sea, and cyber domains, L3Harris is dedicated to enabling mission success through advanced technology and engineering excellence. The company fosters a culture of high performance, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, ensuring that its employees are equipped to meet evolving operational demands. Known for its commitment to community engagement and ethical business practices, L3Harris strives to be a trusted partner in safeguarding the nation and supporting global security initiatives.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Specialist in Software Engineering and Data Analysis to join our dynamic team at L3Harris Technologies. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on cutting-edge defense projects that support national security objectives. The successful candidate will be responsible for modernizing and migrating analytics applications into high-performance web-based solutions utilizing modern web technologies. This position requires an active TS/SCI clearance and may involve periodic travel to Patrick Space Force Base. The role is ideal for individuals passionate about leveraging their technical expertise to develop secure, scalable, and innovative applications that directly impact mission-critical operations.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a bachelor's degree with at least four years of relevant experience, or a graduate degree with a minimum of two years of experience. Alternatively, candidates with a minimum of eight years of applicable experience without a degree will also be considered. An active TS/SCI clearance is mandatory. Additional certifications such as Security+ or DoD IAT Level II are preferred, with the ability to obtain these within six months of employment. Candidates should demonstrate a strong background in full-stack development, cloud computing, and security protocols to succeed in this role.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications, including user interfaces, back-end services, APIs, and data integrations to support mission-critical operations.
Create modern, responsive, and user-friendly front-end solutions using current web frameworks and best practices.
Develop secure, scalable, and resilient back-end services and application logic to support complex mission workflows.
Deploy and manage applications within AWS cloud environments, ensuring solutions are optimized for scalability, security, and cost-efficiency.
Integrate cloud-native services, databases, and application components across distributed environments to enhance operational capabilities.
Apply best practices in software engineering throughout the development lifecycle, including code reviews, automated testing, version control, and CI/CD pipelines.
Collaborate closely with system engineers, cloud specialists, cyber teams, and stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver comprehensive solutions.
Engage with end-users regularly to understand operational needs, gather feedback, and refine application functionality accordingly.
Develop architectural designs, implementation plans, and technical roadmaps aligned with organizational and mission objectives.
Create and maintain detailed technical documentation covering system design, deployment procedures, and sustainment activities.
Deliver technical briefings and presentations to stakeholders, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
Support multiple mission areas, adapting to evolving operational priorities within a dynamic environment.
Maintain familiarity with the C2S Access Portal (CAP) and high-side AWS environments, ensuring compliance with security standards.
Work with various databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, DynamoDB, or other data stores relevant to mission needs.
Obtain and maintain relevant security certifications, supporting compliance and security protocols within classified environments.

Benefits

L3Harris offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and professional growth of its employees. Benefits include competitive salaries, health insurance plans, retirement savings options, paid time off, and opportunities for continuous learning and development. The company promotes a flexible work environment with a 9/80 schedule, allowing employees every other Friday off, fostering work-life balance. Employees also have access to various wellness programs, employee assistance programs, and a supportive community dedicated to innovation and excellence. L3Harris is committed to recognizing and rewarding high performance, providing career advancement opportunities, and fostering an inclusive workplace culture.

Equal Opportunity

L3Harris Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We promote diversity and equal opportunity in all aspects of employment and are dedicated to creating a workplace that values different perspectives and experiences. All employment decisions are made based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We also maintain a drug-free workplace and conduct pre-employment substance abuse testing and background checks where permitted by law.

About SEADC

Southeast Asian Development Center (SEADC) is a San Francisco nonprofit organization whose mission is to foster a healthy, thriving, and self-sufficient Southeast Asian American community. Founded in 1977 in San Francisco’s Tenderloin District, SEADC serves children, youth, adults, and families through culturally responsive programs and services.

SEADC delivers services through two primary program areas: Youth Development and Community and Wellness. Our programs provide youth development, mental health and wellness services, resource navigation, and culturally and linguistically responsive support to help individuals and families access resources, strengthen skills, and improve their well-being.

Learn more about us at: https://seadcenter.org

Summary Of Position

The Project Coordinator supports the coordination, implementation, and delivery of projects within the SEADC’s Community and Wellness program area. The position currently plays a key role in the Southeast Asian Mental Health Initiative (SEAMHI), coordinating SEADC’s work with partner organizations to support cohesive program planning, implementation, data collection, and service delivery. The position also supports the Southeast Asian Support Services project and other Community and Wellness activities as assigned.

The Project Coordinator provides both administrative and direct service support, including coordinating project goals and deliverables, engaging clients in activities that promote mental health and wellness, and connecting clients to appropriate internal and external programs, services, and community resources.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Direct Service (60%)

Conduct community outreach on health and wellness topics and promote relevant resources and SEADC/SEAMHI services.
Develop and update outreach materials and flyers.
Conduct client intake and screening; identify strengths, needs, and goals; complete required forms; and connect clients to appropriate internal and external services.
Support client health and wellness by providing health and risk-reduction education and connecting clients to appropriate health, social, and community services.
Coordinate and facilitate wellness activities, workshops, and presentations.
Coordinate mental health trainings and workshops with funders, licensed therapists, and other partners.
Provide case management, service coordination, and follow-up as needed.
Perform other duties as assigned by the Supervisor.

Administration (40%)

Support implementation and integration of SEADC, CCDI, LSA, and VFS workplans by coordinating tasks, tracking progress, and monitoring project milestones.
Coordinate SEAMHI workgroup meetings, including scheduling, logistics, and meeting documentation.
Assist with managing program supplies, purchases, and expenses within the approved budget.
Maintain accurate and timely client records, data collection, and reporting in Salesforce and other required systems, in compliance with funder and SEADC requirements.
Attend funder, program, and professional development trainings as required.
Perform other duties as assigned by the Supervisor.

Qualification Requirements

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform essential duties satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Knowledge, Experience, And Skill Requirements

Education

Bachelor's degree in psychology, social work, counseling, or related field required; or at least two years of relevant work experience in a similar setting.

Required Skills And Experience

Bilingual in a Southeast Asian language (Khmer, Lao, Thai, or Vietnamese).
Demonstrated knowledge of and cultural competency with Southeast Asian communities.
Knowledge of services and resources available to children, youth, and families in San Francisco.
Experience conducting client interviews, screenings, and assessments.
Experience working with diverse and underserved populations, including youth, adults, low-income individuals, immigrants, and English language learners.
Strong judgment, problem-solving, interpersonal, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, performance-oriented environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
Experience with data entry and CRM systems; Salesforce experience preferred.
Familiarity with project management platforms and communications platforms such as Microsoft Teams.

Additional Qualities And Requirements

Passion for the organization's mission and values.
Attend meetings, trainings, and organizational events outside regular business hours, including occasional evenings and weekends, and travel locally as required. This includes participation in the annual staff strategic planning offsite, staff appreciation event and fundraising events.
Successfully complete fingerprinting background check and TB clearance before start date.
Must be authorized to work in the United States.

Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified applicants and employees as required by law. Applicants who need accommodation during the application or interview process may contact SEADC for assistance.

Job Description

Fabletics
is looking for a Data Analyst II.

How do you fit in?

We are looking for someone who is comfortable writing and understanding intermediate to complex SQL scripts to extract data from a transactional database while looking to take their skills to the next level. This person should also have excellent communication skills to be able to present their findings and analysis back to business stakeholders and executive leaders. The right person is detail-oriented, curious by nature, takes initiative, can work without supervision, begins projects independently, is comfortable with ambiguity, and is technically capable with a deep desire to become an expert in new systems and data structures. They will demonstrate an ability to act as a partner to business teams with a focus on Merch & Planning, merging data with business intuition to answer critical strategy questions. They will demonstrate an aptitude for career advancement & a desire to grow professionally.

This position will report to the Director of Data Analytics
on the Fabletics Data Analytics Team
. The role will be in person on a hybrid schedule at our headquarters in El Segundo, California
. The mission of the analytics team is to provide all FL stakeholders with the Right Data, in the Right Place, at the Right Time and empower stakeholders to make data driven business decisions. We are a creative, ambitious, passionate, & fun-loving team who believes data should be collaborative, impactful, and customized. The successful candidate will be self-motivated and independent, possess excellent analytical skills, and will have the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and succinctly to a range of audiences.

What You Will Do

Prepare data and analysis for Fabletics’ business teams, primarily Merch & Planning; share actionable insights & support teams in translating your findings into executable strategies
Write intermediate to complex SQL queries to extract data from Snowflake in an accurate & efficient manner
Manage our business intelligence platform Tableau, including data modeling, defining internal standards for style, building/maintaining automated reporting, and educating end users on best practices for data analysis
Creative thinker, adept at understanding an array of Merch & Planning analytics use cases and identifying the data necessary to make them a reality
Partner with data engineering teams to suggest improvements for our data architecture
Innovate to advance our stakeholders into more automated and scalable processes

What You Can Bring

High degree of personal integrity, strong work ethic, & a desire to grow in this role.
Minimum 1-3 years of experience in a quantitative analytics role. Advanced SQL skills to extract data and build reports. Strong understanding of relational databases & business intelligence tools. Aptitude for learning deeply complex data concepts.
Experience building data visualizations in Tableau, Looker, or another visualization tool.
Proficient skills in MS Excel, including pivot tables, formulas and charting.
Aptitude for skillfully translating data analysis into business recommendations.
Proven ability to multi-task and balance multiple project priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to communicate with stakeholders.
Desire to apply strategic thinking and analytical skills in a fast-paced, high-growth entrepreneurial environment.
Enthusiastic thought-partner eager to collaborate and contribute to the team and stakeholders.

Nice To Have

Relevant experience with subscription models, ecommerce, fashion/apparel/retail
Experience in a startup business environment
Experience working with Merch & Planning data
Experience working on integrations projects (e.g. partnering with engineering to ingest data from a new vendor & modeling it for analytics consumption)

Why work in Data Analytics at Fabletics?

Be a part of the larger Data Analytics organization at TechStyle Fashion Group (60+ team members); collaborate with analysts, scientists, & engineers of all levels.
Work with an industry leading data technology stack – Snowflake, Tableau, Heap, Segment Customer Data Platform, modeled reporting data warehouses, & more. If you can dream it, you can do it here!
Career advancement opportunities abound in our fast-growing organization – personalized career tracks available including Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Data Sciences, Business Strategy, Product Management, Software Engineering & more.

Where We Are

This role will be based in our El Segundo Headquarters

Compensation & Total Rewards

At Fabletics, we believe work and life should fit together! We continue to build a culture of flexibility, to empower you to do your best and put yourself first. Our Total Rewards program rewards employees for their hard work, supporting their health, well-being, families, and ultimately their life journey. Discretionary Paid Time Off*  
Summer Fridays*  
Healthcare Plans  
Employee Discounts  
401k

Job Description

The Role

The Investment Data Analyst role will be responsible for providing scalable, timely, easily consumable and good quality data for consumption by SAI led products and functions. This position will help drive and define strategy for data analysis, management, acquisition, and distribution. Working closely with SAI business as well as technology partners, the position will participate on projects of various size and complexity, including product/platform development and enhancement.

Skills And Expertise You Bring

Develop and implement a repeatable process aimed at streamlining the data sourcing, aggregation, quality & distribution
Research, recommend and implement automation, digitization, and new scalable solutions for distributing data.
Partner with members of business and technology teams to develop Project and Execution Plans, establish agreed-upon milestones and raise issues, as necessary. Ensure timely production and meet calendar deadlines.
Participate in other data-related efforts to support ad-hoc reporting and analysis.
Operationally monitor, govern, and triage data issues arising from nightly batch or real time data sourcing, working with internal and external partners and vendors.
We are seeking a highly motivated, proactive professional with excellent data and interpersonal skills who are eager to learn about the Managed Accounts solutions!
2 plus years or more in a data intensive, hands on environment, preferably within investment management or technology industries!
Bachelor's Degree required (completed or in progress)
Introductory Fidelity experience; experience with system development projects, business analysis, and data analysis.
Basic knowledge of asset allocation investment products, Performance, Attribution, Fixed Income and Risk related experience.
Good data querying skills using SQL, TOAD, Tableau, Excel, or any other applications.
Prior Experience with Reporting and Visualization Tools like Tableau, Spotfire, Alteryx or other BI, Data Prep, Blending etc.
Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts, R, Python or Scala is preferred.
Understanding of MS Excel (macros, VLOOKUP’s, VBA) and PowerPoint
Basic project management skills and ability to prioritize multiple work streams, track progress and effectively communicate and handle expectations.
Basic analytical skills and business judgment.
Intellectual curiosity and commitment to continuous improvement.
Interest in CFA / CAIA / Financial Certification is good to have but not required.

Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

The
Team

The Data Strategy team is an integral part of Strategic Advisers. We are tasked with the critical responsibility of shaping and driving the overall business strategy. Our team is collaborative and eager to learn, working closely with SAI leaders to define our future and ensure our continued success.

The Center for Massachusetts Bays National Estuary Partnership (MassBays) is a U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) funded program hosted by the School for the Environment at the University of Massachusetts Boston. AECOM’s growing Water business is seeking a motivated Entry-Level Geologist/Geophysicist

This position offers a unique combination of field investigation, technical analysis, and office-based project work. The successful candidate will have opportunities to develop experience across multiple geophysical and geoscience disciplines while working alongside experienced geologists, geophysicists, engineers, surveyors, and GIS professionals.

The position is based in our Germantown, Maryland office and includes a combination of office and field assignments. Depending on project needs, up to approximately 50% travel may be required for field investigations, although the balance between field and office work will vary throughout the year. Field assignments may range from local day trips to occasional multi-week assignments throughout the United States and abroad.

We place a high value on technical aptitude, curiosity, initiative, dependability, and a willingness to learn. The successful candidate should enjoy both solving technical problems in the office and being actively involved in collecting high-quality data in the field.

This position is expected to begin as soon as possible.

Responsibilities include:
Supporting geophysical investigations from field data acquisition through processing, interpretation, mapping, and reporting.
Supporting terrestrial, marine, and borehole investigations using methods including seismic refraction/reflection, MASW, ground penetrating radar (GPR), electromagnetics, magnetics, electrical resistivity imaging, utility mapping, borehole geophysical logging, downhole/crosshole seismic, bathymetric surveying, side-scan sonar, sub-bottom profiling, and marine magnetics and seismic.
Performing technical office work including geophysical data processing and interpretation, GIS analysis and mapping, CAD development, data management, quality control, technical documentation, and report preparation.
Participating in field investigations, including setup and operation of specialized geophysical and survey instrumentation, deployment of sensors and cables, operation of seismic sources, field data quality control, troubleshooting, and equipment mobilization.
Supporting geodetic, geological, and geotechnical services including surveying, GIS mapping, geologic mapping, vibration and settlement monitoring, soil borings and rock coring
Learning to operate specialized geophysical, survey, and data-acquisition equipment and progressively developing the skills necessary to independently perform field and office assignments.
Evaluating field data in real time and working with senior staff to identify and resolve equipment, data-quality, and site-condition issues.
Maintaining organized field documentation and digital data and performing appropriate quality-control checks.
Working collaboratively as part of multidisciplinary project teams and small field crews.
Traveling up to approximately 50% as project needs require.
Working under the supervision of a Project Manager or senior technical team member while progressively taking greater responsibility for technical assignments.

Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word.

Job Description

The Program Coordinator of Food, Activity and Nutrition (FAN) Initiatives builds community and clinical partnerships by leading capacity and awareness building activities to support the coordination, communication and evaluation of food, activity and nutrition programs and initiatives within the Patrick M. Magoon Institute for Healthy Communities. This includes coordinating the implementation of existing FAN programs and assisting with the planning, development, and implementation of future initiatives. This position directly supports food access programming for patients and works collaboratively with external community partners and internal Lurie programs.

The position helps advance Lurie Children’s broader mission to improve the health and wellbeing of children, youth, families and communities by supporting community health initiatives, site operations and special projects aligned with the priorities of the Patrick M. Magoon Institute for Healthy Communities and the Community Health Improvement Strategy.

This position is part of the Food, Activity and Nutrition Initiatives team within the Patrick M. Magoon Institute for Healthy Communities, Lurie Children’s hub for community-focused initiatives. The Magoon Institute brings together clinical care, advocacy, research, education and community engagement to advance community health and health equity for infants, children, adolescents and families across Chicago. The Institute also leads Lurie Children’s Community Health Needs Assessment and Community Health Improvement Strategy, which guide the hospital’s community health priorities and investments.

The Food, Activity and Nutrition (FAN) Initiatives team collaborates with key partners on local, state-wide and national levels to help ensure that supports for healthy eating and being physically active are always within reach for youth and their families where they live, learn, and play. FAN aims to improve the health and well-being of Chicagoland children, adolescents, and their families by addressing nutrition security, physical activity, and related chronic health conditions through community partnership, clinical collaboration, and improving upstream health factors.

Advanced experience designing and maintaining Microsoft Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, DAX measures, and Power Query transformations required. Skills & Abilities: Advanced analytical, technical, communication, and project management skills. Ability to independently lead complex analytics projects from requirements gathering through design, validation, deployment, adoption, and ongoing maintenance. Strong understanding of data quality, metric definitions, regulatory reporting, confidentiality, HIPAA-sensitive data handling, and stakeholder communication. Ability to explain complex technical concepts to clinical, operational, and executive audiences. Ability to manage competing priorities, mentor others, facilitate consensus around data definitions, and maintain a high degree of accuracy, dependability, and attention to detail. Proactively identify reporting gaps and efficiently move projects from intake through adoption with limited direction.

Essential Functions:

Enterprise Analytics and Reporting

Lead the design, development, validation, implementation, and ongoing optimization of enterprise reporting and analytics solutions that support clinical, operational, administrative, financial, regulatory, foundation, and strategic business functions.
Translate complex organizational questions into analytical frameworks, metrics, dashboards, data models, and actionable recommendations that support data-informed decisions at the department, committee, and executive levels.
Independently evaluate and scope analytics requests and recommend priorities in collaboration with leadership and stakeholders, considering organizational value and strategic alignment, regulatory urgency, data readiness, technical feasibility, resource requirements, and long-term supportability.
Use SQL, Power Query, DAX, and related tools to extract, transform, join, reconcile, and validate data from hospital systems, data warehouse environments, foundation or business systems, and other approved data sources.
Develop reporting solutions that balance accuracy, usability, sustainability, performance, confidentiality, and the needs of both technical and non-technical audiences.

Power BI and Microsoft Fabric Leadership

Serve as the hospital's subject-matter-expert for Microsoft Power BI and reporting, including semantic model design, DAX development, data visualization standards, report governance, workspace organization, and report life cycle management.
Support organization-wide implementation, adoption, and effective use of Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric by helping define reporting standards, development practices, access expectations, documentation requirements, and sustainable support models.
Collaborate with data owners and operational stakeholders to align reporting solutions with Microsoft Fabric architecture, approved data sources, data security expectations, and enterprise analytics priorities.
Establish, document, and follow appropriate development, testing, user acceptance, deployment, change-control, and retirement practices for assigned reporting assets, consistent with organizational standards.
Review and improve report logic, semantic models, data refresh processes, measure definitions, dashboard usability, and performance to strengthen trust and consistency in organizational reporting.
Monitor the reliability of assigned production reporting solutions, investigate failures or material discrepancies, communicate impacts to affected stakeholders, and coordinate timely correction and validation.

Training, Consultation, and Data Literacy

The successful candidate will have opportunities to develop experience across multiple geophysical and geoscience disciplines while working alongside experienced geologists, geophysicists, engineers, surveyors, and GIS professionals.

Supporting geophysical investigations from field data acquisition through processing, interpretation, mapping, and reporting.

Performing technical office work including geophysical data processing and interpretation, GIS analysis and mapping, CAD development, data management, quality control, technical documentation, and report preparation.
Participating in field investigations, including setup and operation of specialized geophysical and survey instrumentation, deployment of sensors and cables, operation of seismic sources, field data quality control, troubleshooting, and equipment mobilization.

Maintaining organized field documentation and digital data and performing appropriate quality-control checks.
Working collaboratively as part of multidisciplinary project teams and small field crews.
Traveling up to approximately 50% as project needs require.
